2 Bedroom Apartment | 2 Bathrooms | 1,194.90 sq.ft | Sobha Creek Vistas Grande

Spacious and modern 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in Sobha Creek Vistas Grande, located in the prestigious Sobha Hartland community.

Features:

1,194.90 sq.ft of living space
Open-plan living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows with scenic views
Fully equipped modern kitchen
Built-in wardrobes in both bedrooms
Contemporary bathrooms with high-quality finishes
Access to swimming pool, gym, landscaped gardens
Dedicated parking space
Conveniently close to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and major transport links

This property offers a perfect combination of comfort, style, and connectivity, ideal for professionals, families, or anyone seeking a modern urban lifestyle in a vibrant community.
